author: gta6plus
text:
In GTA 6, a new haircut won't fool the cops if you're still wearing the outfit they saw.

Rockstar's Rob Nelson explained the escape options in IGN's full interview:

- Keep spare outfits in your car's trunk so you can change out of clothes the cops recognize.
- Split Jason and Lucia up. Police can recognize them as a couple, so separating helps.
- Switch cars to make it harder for the cops to recognize you.
- With three stars in the city, escaping on foot through alleys can be a better option than staying in a car.
- Some stolen cars have trackers that ping the cops when you drive too slowly.
